ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Full Scope of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the full scope of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the individuals and organizations involved, and the methods used to carry out the scheme.
questions: Who else was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. I will use my investigative skills to follow the money and uncover the full scope of the scheme.
